consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, which the engine EVALUATES as a yes/no to decide whether the courier job can be handed in
scope: the player's crafting_inventory() reach (carried plus nearby reachable item sources), not merely the avatar's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body queries u.crafting_inventory() and returns whether has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (or the has_charges fallback) is satisfied
divergence: the required courier item sits in a reachable adjacent container/vehicle within crafting reach but is not on the avatar's body: crafting_inventory counts it so is_complete returns true, while a re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] (wielded/worn/inventory only) reports not-complete — exposing the wrong-scope answer
